works.name: Lucas–Kanade / Inverse Compositional
works.group: 图像配准、拼接与视频稳像
works.summary: 用图像残差优化 warp 参数；逆组合形式允许复用部分计算，是直接法对齐的重要基础
works.caveat: 对初始化、光度假设和局部极小值敏感

en.summary: Optimizes warp parameters using image residuals. The inverse compositional formulation reuses parts of the computation and remains a foundation of direct image alignment.
en.caveat: Sensitive to initialization, photometric assumptions and local minima.

works.paper_title: Lucas-Kanade 20 Years On: A Unifying Framework

works.name: Horn–Schunck
works.group: 参数化几何与运动估计
works.summary: 亮度一致性与全局平滑正则结合，建立稠密变分光流的经典范式
works.caveat: 运动边界易过度平滑；基础形式不适合大位移

en.summary: Combines brightness constancy with a global smoothness regularizer, establishing a classical variational formulation of dense optical flow.
en.caveat: The basic formulation can oversmooth motion boundaries and struggles with large displacement.

works.paper_title: Determining optical flow

works.name: Brox et al. Variational Optical Flow
works.group: 参数化几何与运动估计
works.summary: 结合亮度/梯度一致性和保边正则，为粗到细 warping 的数值求解提供理论解释
works.caveat: 强光照变化与严重遮挡会破坏数据假设

extra_links.label: High Accuracy Optical Flow Estimation Based on a Theory for Warping

en.summary: Combines brightness and gradient constancy with edge-preserving regularization, and gives a theoretical interpretation of coarse-to-fine warping in the numerical solver.
en.caveat: Large illumination changes and severe occlusion violate its data assumptions.

works.paper_title: High Accuracy Optical Flow Estimation Based on a Theory for Warping

works.name: PWC-Net
works.group: 参数化几何与运动估计
works.summary: 金字塔 + 特征 warping + cost volume，学习粗到细残余运动
works.caveat: 逐层 warping 的误差可能传播；遮挡仍需额外处理

en.summary: Combines feature pyramids, feature warping and cost volumes to learn residual motion from coarse to fine.
en.caveat: Errors can propagate between pyramid levels; occlusions require additional treatment.

works.paper_title: PWC-Net: CNNs for Optical Flow Using Pyramid, Warping, and Cost Volume

works.name: RAFT
works.group: 参数化几何与运动估计
works.summary: 全像素对相关体与循环更新，成为稠密流估计的重要基线
works.caveat: 相关体开销随分辨率增加；它估计 flow，不是新的图像插值核

en.summary: Builds all-pairs correlation volumes and updates a dense flow field recurrently, providing an influential baseline for correspondence estimation.
en.caveat: Correlation storage grows with resolution. RAFT estimates flow; it does not introduce a new image interpolation kernel.

works.paper_title: RAFT: Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms for Optical Flow

works.name: Free-Form Deformation (FFD)
works.group: 控制点、样条与局部形状
works.summary: Sederberg–Parry 通过控制格与 Bernstein 多项式变形几何对象，奠定体积控制形变基础
works.caveat: 格分辨率控制细节与复杂度；不自动保证无折叠

en.summary: Sederberg and Parry deform geometric objects through a control lattice and Bernstein polynomials, establishing a foundation for volumetric free-form deformation.
en.caveat: Lattice resolution trades detail against complexity; the model does not automatically prevent folding.

works.paper_title: Free-Form Deformation of Solid Geometric Models

works.name: Thin-Plate Spline (TPS) / Principal Warps
works.group: 控制点、样条与局部形状
works.summary: Bookstein 将 TPS 用于地标形变分析，以弯曲能量定义平滑非刚性映射；TPS 的数学起源更早
works.caveat: 全局支撑、离群控制点和边界外推可能产生不自然形变

en.summary: Bookstein uses thin-plate splines for landmark-based deformation analysis, defining smooth nonrigid maps through bending energy. The underlying mathematics of TPS predates this paper.
en.caveat: Global support, outlier landmarks and extrapolation can produce implausible deformation.

works.paper_title: Principal warps: thin-plate splines and the decomposition of deformations

works.name: Beier–Neely Feature-Based Morphing
works.group: 控制点、样条与局部形状
works.summary: 用成对特征线段控制 inverse warp，再结合颜色混合实现 morphing
works.caveat: 依赖手工对应；复杂区域可能产生局部扭曲

en.summary: Uses corresponding feature-line pairs to control an inverse warp, then blends image colors to produce morphing effects.
en.caveat: Requires manually specified correspondences and can distort complex regions.

works.paper_title: Feature-Based Image Metamorphosis

works.name: B-spline FFD Registration
works.group: 控制点、样条与局部形状
works.summary: Rueckert 等将全局仿射与局部 B-spline FFD 结合，用于乳腺 MR 非刚性配准
works.caveat: 普通 B-spline FFD 不自动满足微分同胚约束

en.summary: Rueckert and colleagues combine global affine alignment with local B-spline free-form deformation for nonrigid breast MR registration.
en.caveat: An ordinary B-spline FFD does not automatically satisfy diffeomorphic constraints.

works.paper_title: Nonrigid registration using free-form deformations: application to breast MR images

works.name: Moving Least Squares (MLS)
works.group: 控制点、样条与局部形状
works.summary: Schaefer 等用局部加权拟合构造仿射、相似、刚性图像形变，支持交互控制
works.caveat: 权重、控制点布局与外推影响结果；不是全局可逆性的保证

en.summary: Schaefer and colleagues construct affine, similarity and rigid image deformations through locally weighted fitting, enabling interactive point and line controls.
en.caveat: Results depend on weights, landmark layout and extrapolation; local fitting does not guarantee global invertibility.

works.paper_title: Image deformation using moving least squares

works.name: As-Rigid-As-Possible (ARAP) Surface Modeling
works.group: 控制点、样条与局部形状
works.summary: Sorkine–Alexa 以局部刚性约束保留形状细节，是网格编辑的经典能量设计
works.caveat: 需要网格与优化；大形变仍可能自交

en.summary: Sorkine and Alexa preserve local shape through an as-rigid-as-possible energy, establishing a widely used approach to detail-preserving mesh editing.
en.caveat: Requires a mesh and numerical optimization; large deformations may still self-intersect.

works.paper_title: As-Rigid-As-Possible Surface Modeling

works.name: Content-Preserving Warps for 3D Video Stabilization
works.group: 控制点、样条与局部形状
works.summary: 由三维相机运动与内容保持网格 warp 构造稳定视频，兼顾对齐和显著区域形状
works.caveat: 依赖可靠运动重建；裁切、深度差异与残余畸变存在权衡

en.summary: Combines reconstructed 3D camera motion with content-preserving mesh warps to stabilize video while balancing alignment and salient-region shape.
en.caveat: Depends on reliable motion reconstruction, with trade-offs between cropping, depth variation and residual distortion.

works.paper_title: Content-Preserving Warps for 3D Video Stabilization

works.name: As-Projective-As-Possible (APAP) / Moving DLT
works.group: 控制点、样条与局部形状
works.summary: Zaragoza 等允许局部偏离全局投影变换，以适应拼接中的非平面与视差
works.caveat: 大视差、重遮挡和非重叠区域的外推仍有挑战

en.summary: Zaragoza and colleagues allow local departures from a global projective map through Moving DLT, accommodating parallax and nonplanarity in image stitching.
en.caveat: Large parallax, heavy occlusion and extrapolation outside overlap remain challenging.

works.paper_title: As-Projective-As-Possible Image Stitching with Moving DLT

works.name: LDDMM / Geodesic Flows of Diffeomorphisms
works.group: 拓扑保持与医学配准
works.summary: Beg 等通过平滑速度场的时间积分与测地流构造大形变微分同胚映射，是计算解剖的重要基础
works.caveat: 优化与数值积分成本较高；离散精度和正则尺度影响结果

en.summary: Beg and colleagues construct large diffeomorphic deformations through smooth velocity fields and geodesic flows, forming a foundation of computational anatomy.
en.caveat: Optimization and numerical integration can be expensive; discretization and regularization scale affect results.

works.paper_title: Computing Large Deformation Metric Mappings via Geodesic Flows of Diffeomorphisms

works.name: SyN: Symmetric Diffeomorphic Registration
works.group: 拓扑保持与医学配准
works.summary: 对称微分同胚配准，结合互相关用于解剖图像对齐，是 ANTs 的代表性方法
works.caveat: 逐对优化成本较高；结果依赖相似度、正则与离散化

en.summary: Uses symmetric diffeomorphic registration with cross-correlation for anatomical alignment; SyN is a representative method in ANTs.
en.caveat: Pairwise optimization can be costly, and results depend on similarity measures, regularization and discretization.

works.paper_title: Symmetric Diffeomorphic Image Registration with Cross-Correlation: Evaluating Automated Labeling of Elderly and Neurodegenerative Brain

works.name: Diffeomorphic Demons
works.group: 拓扑保持与医学配准
works.summary: 在 Demons 框架中使用微分同胚更新，兼顾高效非参数配准与平滑可逆变形
works.caveat: 数学模型的可逆性不免除数值 Jacobian 检查

en.summary: Introduces diffeomorphic updates within the Demons framework, combining efficient nonparametric registration with smooth, invertible deformation models.
en.caveat: The continuous model's invertibility does not remove the need to inspect numerical Jacobians.

works.paper_title: Diffeomorphic demons: Efficient non-parametric image registration

works.name: VoxelMorph
works.group: 拓扑保持与医学配准
works.summary: 将逐对优化摊销为网络预测形变场，结合可微 warp 与图像相似性训练
works.caveat: 基础位移场版本与微分同胚扩展应区分；有数据分布依赖

en.summary: Amortizes pairwise optimization into a network that predicts deformation fields, trained with differentiable warping and image-similarity objectives.
en.caveat: Distinguish the baseline displacement-field model from diffeomorphic extensions; performance depends on the training distribution.

works.paper_title: VoxelMorph: A Learning Framework for Deformable Medical Image Registration

works.name: EWA Volume Splatting
works.group: 可微采样与抗混叠
works.summary: 用椭圆加权平均核处理投影重建与低通滤波，是理解 splatting 足迹和抗混叠的经典工作
works.caveat: 体渲染算子，不能直接等同于二维光流 warp 或后来的 3DGS 系统

en.summary: Uses elliptical weighted-average kernels for projected reconstruction and low-pass filtering, providing a classic reference for splat footprints and antialiasing.
en.caveat: This is a volume-rendering operator, not the same operation as 2D optical-flow warping or a complete modern 3DGS system.

works.paper_title: EWA Volume Splatting

works.name: Spatial Transformer Networks (STN)
works.group: 可微采样与抗混叠
works.summary: 参数预测、网格生成和可微采样联合训练，使空间变换可嵌入神经网络
works.caveat: 学到的变换受参数化限制；双线性采样不负责遮挡补全与严格抗混叠

en.summary: Jointly trains transformation prediction, grid generation and differentiable sampling, making spatial transformation a learnable neural-network module.
en.caveat: The transformation family limits expressiveness. Bilinear sampling does not itself solve occlusion completion or rigorous antialiasing.

works.paper_title: Spatial Transformer Networks

works.name: Softmax Splatting
works.group: 可微采样与 Splatting
works.summary: Niklaus–Liu 用 softmax 加权处理 forward warp 的多对一冲突，并支持图像和特征的可微前向投影
works.caveat: 依赖 flow 与重要性度量；反遮挡空洞需要合成网络或其他补全

en.summary: Niklaus and Liu use softmax weighting to resolve many-to-one conflicts in a differentiable forward warp, supporting both image and feature splatting.
en.caveat: Depends on the flow and importance metric; disocclusion holes still need synthesis or another completion mechanism.

works.paper_title: Softmax Splatting for Video Frame Interpolation

works.name: Depth-Image-Based Rendering (DIBR)
works.group: 特征对齐、动画与三维形变
works.summary: 用颜色图与深度生成虚拟视角，是理解深度重投影、遮挡和空洞的经典路线；该论文不是重投影思想的首次提出
works.caveat: 深度边界、反遮挡和投影冲突需专门处理

en.summary: Synthesizes virtual views from color and depth, providing a classic route to depth reprojection, visibility reasoning and hole handling. This paper did not originate the general idea of reprojection.
en.caveat: Depth discontinuities, disocclusion and projection collisions require dedicated handling.

works.paper_title: Depth-image-based rendering (DIBR), compression, and transmission for a new approach on 3D-TV

works.name: Deformable ConvNets (DCN)
works.group: 可微采样与 Splatting
works.summary: 为卷积采样位置学习 offset，使特征支持局部几何适应
works.caveat: 每个核位置有偏移，不等价于一个全图物理运动场

en.summary: Learns offsets for convolutional sampling locations, allowing features to adapt to local geometric variation.
en.caveat: Offsets are associated with individual kernel samples and are not equivalent to one physically meaningful global motion field.

works.paper_title: Deformable Convolutional Networks

works.name: CP-VTON
works.group: 特征对齐、动画与三维形变
works.summary: 用 Geometric Matching Module 学习 TPS，将商品服装形变到人体，再学习融合掩码
works.caveat: TPS 对大姿态变化、复杂遮挡和细纹理的表示有限

en.summary: Learns a TPS with a geometric matching module to align an in-shop garment with a person, then learns a composition mask.
en.caveat: TPS has limited capacity for large pose changes, complex occlusion and fine clothing details.

works.paper_title: Toward Characteristic-Preserving Image-based Virtual Try-On Network

works.name: Monodepth2
works.group: 特征对齐、动画与三维形变
works.summary: 用深度、位姿和可微重投影进行自监督视图重建，引入最小重投影误差与自动掩码
works.caveat: 是深度估计系统；几何 warp 仍受动态物体、反光与不可见区域影响

en.summary: Uses depth, pose and differentiable reprojection for self-supervised view reconstruction, introducing minimum reprojection loss and automasking.
en.caveat: A depth-estimation system rather than a standalone warp operator; dynamic objects, reflections and unobserved regions remain challenges.

works.paper_title: Digging Into Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation

works.name: First Order Motion Model (FOMM)
works.group: 特征对齐、动画与三维形变
works.summary: 自学习关键点与局部一阶仿射运动，构造稠密特征 warp 和遮挡图实现图像动画
works.caveat: 大身份差异、大旋转与显著反遮挡仍困难

en.summary: Learns keypoints and local first-order affine motion to construct dense feature warps and occlusion maps for image animation.
en.caveat: Large identity differences, rotations and disocclusions remain difficult.

works.paper_title: First Order Motion Model for Image Animation

works.name: D-NeRF
works.group: 特征对齐、动画与三维形变
works.summary: 学习时间条件形变，把动态场景坐标映射到 canonical radiance field
works.caveat: 单目重建有歧义，动态细节和训练效率受限

en.summary: Learns time-conditioned deformation that maps dynamic-scene coordinates into a canonical radiance field.
en.caveat: Monocular reconstruction is ambiguous; dynamic detail and training efficiency are limited.

works.paper_title: D-NeRF: Neural Radiance Fields for Dynamic Scenes

works.name: Nerfies
works.group: 特征对齐、动画与三维形变
works.summary: 连续三维形变场、弹性正则与粗到细优化，重建随意拍摄的非刚性场景
works.caveat: 连续 canonical warp 难以处理拓扑变化；优化可能陷入局部极小值

en.summary: Combines continuous 3D deformation, elastic regularization and coarse-to-fine optimization to reconstruct casually captured nonrigid scenes.
en.caveat: Continuous canonical warps struggle with topology changes, and optimization may reach local minima.

works.paper_title: Nerfies: Deformable Neural Radiance Fields

works.name: HyperNeRF
works.group: 特征对齐、动画与三维形变
works.summary: 把表示提升到高维空间，通过切片建模拓扑变化，扩展普通连续三维 warp 的能力
works.caveat: 高维表示不是对三维空间直接构造一个处处可逆的形变

en.summary: Lifts the representation into a higher-dimensional space and uses slices to model topology changes beyond ordinary continuous 3D warps.
en.caveat: The higher-dimensional representation is not an everywhere-invertible deformation of ordinary 3D space.

works.paper_title: HyperNeRF: A Higher-Dimensional Representation for Topologically Varying Neural Radiance Fields

works.name: GMFlow
works.summary: Transformer 增强跨图特征，以全局匹配生成 flow，减少对大量顺序迭代的依赖
works.caveat: 改进 flow 估计而非重采样核；预印本 **2021**

en.summary: Uses Transformer-enhanced cross-image features and global matching to estimate flow with less reliance on long sequences of iterative refinement.
en.caveat: Improves correspondence estimation rather than the resampling kernel; the preprint appeared in 2021.

works.paper_title: GMFlow: Learning Optical Flow via Global Matching

works.name: FlowFormer
works.summary: 对 4D cost volume 进行 Transformer 编码，并通过循环解码更新运动
works.caveat: 需要关注相关表示和高分辨率显存开销

en.summary: Encodes a 4D cost volume with Transformers and recurrently decodes motion updates.
en.caveat: The cost representation and high-resolution memory requirements need consideration.

works.paper_title: FlowFormer: A Transformer Architecture for Optical Flow

works.name: Thin-Plate Spline Motion Model for Image Animation
works.summary: 从局部仿射运动扩展到多个 TPS 变换，并结合多尺度遮挡掩码进行特征形变
works.caveat: 经典 TPS 的学习式组合，不是新发明 TPS；极端身份差异仍有限

en.summary: Extends local affine motion representations to multiple TPS transformations, using multiscale occlusion masks for feature warping in image animation.
en.caveat: A learned composition of classical TPS models, not the invention of TPS itself; extreme identity differences remain challenging.

works.paper_title: Thin-Plate Spline Motion Model for Image Animation

works.name: FILM: Frame Interpolation for Large Motion
works.summary: 跨尺度共享的特征与运动估计，提高大运动插帧能力；可仅从图像帧训练
works.caveat: 大反遮挡区域仍需合成；不是单一通用 warp 算子

en.summary: Shares feature extraction and motion estimation across scales to improve large-motion frame interpolation using training from image frames alone.
en.caveat: Large disocclusions still require synthesis; this is an interpolation system rather than one universal warp operator.

works.paper_title: FILM: Frame Interpolation for Large Motion

works.name: TransMorph
works.summary: Transformer–ConvNet 混合模型用于三维医学配准，增强长程空间关系建模
works.caveat: 预印本 **2021**；是否微分同胚取决于具体模型版本

en.summary: Uses a hybrid Transformer–ConvNet architecture to model long-range relationships in volumetric medical registration.
en.caveat: The preprint appeared in 2021. Whether a variant is diffeomorphic depends on its specific formulation.

works.paper_title: TransMorph: Transformer for unsupervised medical image registration

works.name: SynthMorph
works.summary: 用合成标签和多样图像训练，提升跨 MRI 对比度的形变配准泛化
works.caveat: 预印本 **2020**；进步主要来自训练策略与泛化能力

en.summary: Trains with synthetic label maps and diverse image appearances to improve deformable registration across MRI contrasts.
en.caveat: The preprint appeared in 2020; the main advance concerns training strategy and generalization.

works.paper_title: SynthMorph: learning contrast-invariant registration without acquired images

works.name: BasicVSR++
works.summary: 二阶传播与 flow-guided deformable alignment，把光流先验与可形变特征采样结合
works.caveat: 预印本 **2021**；针对视频复原系统

en.summary: Combines second-order propagation with flow-guided deformable alignment to integrate optical-flow priors and adaptive feature sampling for video restoration.
en.caveat: The preprint appeared in 2021; the method is part of a video-restoration pipeline.

works.paper_title: BasicVSR++: Improving Video Super-Resolution with Enhanced Propagation and Alignment

works.name: UDIS++: Parallax-Tolerant Unsupervised Deep Image Stitching
works.summary: 全局 homography + 局部 TPS，联合考虑重叠区对齐、非重叠区形状与接缝合成
works.caveat: 对大视差的容忍不意味着解决所有三维遮挡

en.summary: Combines global homography with local TPS, jointly considering overlap alignment, non-overlap shape preservation and seam composition.
en.caveat: Tolerance of large parallax does not imply that all 3D visibility and occlusion problems are solved.

works.paper_title: Parallax-Tolerant Unsupervised Deep Image Stitching

works.name: UniMatch: Unifying Flow, Stereo and Depth Estimation
works.summary: 把 flow、双目视差与有位姿的跨视图深度统一为对应匹配任务
works.caveat: 预印本 **2022**；输出、几何约束和细化仍随任务变化

en.summary: Unifies optical flow, stereo disparity and depth from posed views as dense correspondence-matching problems.
en.caveat: The preprint appeared in 2022; output structure, geometric constraints and refinement still depend on the task.

works.paper_title: Unifying Flow, Stereo and Depth Estimation

works.name: ImWIP
works.summary: 提供可微图像 warp 及其精确离散伴随与导数，服务逆问题优化
works.caveat: 伴随 `Wᵀ` 不等于逆 warp；精确性针对选定离散算子和浮点精度

en.summary: Provides differentiable image-warp operators with exact discrete adjoints and derivatives for inverse-problem optimization.
en.caveat: The adjoint is not an inverse warp. Exactness concerns the selected discretization, up to floating-point error.

works.paper_title: ImWIP: Open-source image warping toolbox with adjoints and derivatives

works.name: Deformable 3D Gaussians
works.summary: 在 canonical Gaussian 表示上学习形变场，将动态重建与快速 splatting 渲染结合
works.caveat: 三维参数形变 + 渲染，不等同于二维图像插值；有逐场景优化需求

en.summary: Learns a deformation field over canonical Gaussians, combining dynamic reconstruction with fast splatting-based rendering.
en.caveat: Deforms 3D parameters before rendering rather than simply interpolating a 2D image; requires per-scene optimization.

works.paper_title: Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

works.name: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering
works.summary: 结合时空特征与 Gaussian 形变，提升动态场景表示的训练、存储及渲染效率
works.caveat: 此处专指 Wu 等的 4D-GS，不泛指所有名字含 4D Gaussian 的方法

en.summary: Combines spatiotemporal features with Gaussian deformation to improve training, storage and rendering efficiency for dynamic scenes.
en.caveat: This entry specifically refers to the 4D-GS method by Wu and colleagues, not every method named 4D Gaussian Splatting.

works.paper_title: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering

works.name: StabStitch
works.summary: 将视频拼接与稳像统一到无监督在线框架，约束空间对齐和时间稳定性，抑制逐帧 warp 抖动
works.caveat: 图像级对齐好不等于视频稳定；仍需比较延迟、畸变和动态场景效果

en.summary: Unifies video stitching and stabilization in an unsupervised online framework, constraining spatial alignment and temporal stability to suppress warping shake.
en.caveat: Good image-level alignment does not guarantee stable video; latency, distortion and dynamic-scene behavior need separate evaluation.

works.paper_title: Eliminating Warping Shakes for Unsupervised Online Video Stitching

works.name: SEA-RAFT
works.summary: 通过初始 flow 回归、混合 Laplace 损失和刚性运动预训练，改善 RAFT 的效率与精度
works.caveat: 属于对应估计的工程与建模改进；效果依赖评测协议

en.summary: Improves RAFT's efficiency and accuracy through initial-flow regression, a mixture-of-Laplace loss and rigid-motion pretraining.
en.caveat: An improvement to correspondence estimation; outcomes depend on the evaluation protocol.

works.paper_title: SEA-RAFT: Simple, Efficient, Accurate RAFT for Optical Flow

works.name: uniGradICON
works.summary: 将学习式配准推进到多数据集、跨解剖区域和新任务的通用初始化与零样本使用
works.caveat: 泛化并非对任意模态、任意器官的保证

en.summary: Moves learned registration toward a reusable model across datasets, anatomical regions and new tasks, including zero-shot use and initialization for adaptation.
en.caveat: Generalization is not guaranteed for arbitrary modalities or anatomy.

works.paper_title: uniGradICON: A Foundation Model for Medical Image Registration

works.name: GenWarp
works.summary: 结合深度诱导的坐标信息与跨视图/自注意力，让模型学习保留可迁移内容并生成缺失部分
works.caveat: 属于 generative warping，生成区域并非从源图精确搬运

en.summary: Combines depth-induced coordinate information with cross-view and self-attention, learning which content to transfer and which missing regions to generate.
en.caveat: Generative warping does not mean that generated regions are exact copies transported from the source image.

works.paper_title: GenWarp: Single Image to Novel Views with Semantic-Preserving Generative Warping

works.name: How I Warped Your Noise / ∫-noise
works.summary: 把像素噪声解释为连续白噪声场的区域积分，设计面向 Gaussian 统计的输运，兼顾运动相关性和噪声性质
works.caveat: 与普通 RGB 插值目标不同；会议早于 **2025** arXiv 上传，不能按该 ID 误判为 2025 首发

en.summary: Interprets pixel noise as integrals over a continuous white-noise field and designs transport for Gaussian statistics while retaining motion-induced temporal correlation.
en.caveat: The goal differs from ordinary RGB interpolation. Its 2025 arXiv upload postdates the ICLR 2024 paper and should not be treated as the first publication.

works.paper_title: How I Warped Your Noise: a Temporally-Correlated Noise Prior for Diffusion Models

works.name: Warped Diffusion
works.group: 噪声 Warping 与时序一致性
works.summary: 用连续函数空间和变换等变性处理视频逆问题，以测试时自等变引导提高时序一致性
works.caveat: 不是仅对初始化噪声做一次 warp；关注视频补全与超分

en.summary: Uses continuous function spaces and transformation equivariance for video inverse problems, improving temporal consistency with test-time self-equivariance guidance.
en.caveat: Not simply a one-time warp of initialization noise; the applications include video inpainting and super-resolution.

works.paper_title: Warped Diffusion: Solving Video Inverse Problems with Image Diffusion Models

works.name: Go-with-the-Flow
works.summary: 高效生成 warped noise 并微调视频模型，把运动模式作为噪声先验，用于运动迁移及相机/物体控制
works.caveat: 需要相应模型适配；普通 pretrained 模型不必然直接支持相同控制

en.summary: Efficiently constructs warped noise and adapts video diffusion models to use it as a motion prior for motion transfer and camera or object control.
en.caveat: Requires the corresponding model adaptation; an arbitrary pretrained model does not necessarily support the same control mechanism.

works.paper_title: Go-with-the-Flow: Motion-Controllable Video Diffusion Models Using Real-Time Warped Noise

works.name: MEMFOF
works.summary: 精简相关表示并引入多帧估计与高分辨率训练，推进原生 FullHD 光流的显存效率
works.caveat: 不是新的采样核；资源数据应按作者指定硬件、精度和分辨率复测

en.summary: Combines reduced correlation representations, multiframe estimation and high-resolution training to improve memory efficiency for native FullHD optical flow.
en.caveat: Not a new sampling kernel; resource figures should be reproduced under the authors' resolution, precision and hardware settings.

works.paper_title: MEMFOF: High-Resolution Training for Memory-Efficient Multi-Frame Optical Flow Estimation

works.name: LookingGlass / Laplacian Pyramid Warping (LPW)
works.summary: 用 Laplacian 金字塔进行频率感知的图像 warp 与视图聚合，支持多视角生成式 anamorphosis
works.caveat: 主要针对多变换生成与频率保真，不直接保证随机噪声统计

en.summary: Uses Laplacian pyramids for frequency-aware image warping and view aggregation, enabling multiview generative anamorphoses.
en.caveat: Targets detail preservation and synchronization across transformed views, not a direct guarantee of random-noise statistics.

works.paper_title: LookingGlass: Generative Anamorphoses via Laplacian Pyramid Warping

works.name: WAVE: Warp-Based View Guidance
works.summary: 用视图 warping 引导自适应 attention 与噪声重新初始化，提高单图新视角一致性，无需额外训练
works.caveat: 依赖基础新视角模型与几何估计；与其他同名 WAVE 工作应区分；作者论文所列项目页在本次核验时返回 404，暂不提供失效入口

en.summary: Uses view warping to guide adaptive attention and noise reinitialization, improving single-image novel-view consistency without additional training.
en.caveat: Depends on the base novel-view model and geometric estimates. Distinguish it from other WAVE papers. The authors' original project URL returned 404 during verification and is omitted.

works.paper_title: WAVE: Warp-Based View Guidance for Consistent Novel View Synthesis Using a Single Image

works.name: SplatDiff: High-Fidelity Novel View Synthesis via Splatting-Guided Diffusion
works.summary: 以 pixel splatting 约束目标视角，结合对齐合成与 texture bridge，平衡几何一致性和纹理保真
works.caveat: 深度和 splat 错误仍可能传播；生成细节需要单独核验真实性

en.summary: Uses pixel splatting to constrain target views and combines aligned synthesis with a texture bridge to balance geometric consistency and texture fidelity.
en.caveat: Depth and splatting errors can propagate; the faithfulness of generated detail requires separate verification.

works.paper_title: High-Fidelity Novel View Synthesis via Splatting-Guided Diffusion

works.name: CameraNoise
works.summary: 以 Geometry-guided Reprojection Flow 与噪声 warping 将相机运动编码到时序相关噪声中，同时关注 Gaussian 先验与轨迹控制
works.caveat: 效果依赖场景几何和运动估计；不能据此推导任意非刚性运动均可精确控制

en.summary: Uses geometry-guided reprojection flow and noise warping to encode camera motion into temporally correlated noise, while preserving the Gaussian prior and trajectory control.
en.caveat: Depends on scene geometry and motion estimates; the results do not imply exact control of arbitrary nonrigid motion.

works.paper_title: CameraNoise: Enabling Faithful Camera Control in Video Diffusion through Geometry-Flow-Guided Noise Warping

works.name: WarpI2I
works.summary: 在编码前用 saliency-guided warp 向显著区域分配更多空间表示，处理后 unwarp，改善紧凑 latent 模型的结构保留
works.caveat: 用 warp 分配表示预算，不以运动估计为核心；逆映射受数值采样影响

en.summary: Uses a saliency-guided warp before encoding to allocate more spatial representation to salient regions, then unwarps the output to improve structural preservation in compact latent models.
en.caveat: Uses warping to allocate representation capacity rather than primarily to estimate motion; inverse mapping remains subject to resampling error.

works.paper_title: WarpI2I: Image Warping for Image-to-Image Translation

works.name: Warp-as-History
works.summary: 将相机诱导的 warp 作为对齐目标位置的伪历史，结合有效 token 选择利用冻结模型的历史输入通路；另探索单视频 LoRA
works.caveat: 截止本版仅按公开预印本收录；控制能力仍需跨数据与轨迹验证

en.summary: Turns camera-induced warps into pseudo-history aligned with target positions, selecting valid tokens to use a frozen model's visual-history pathway; also explores single-video LoRA adaptation.
en.caveat: Listed as a public preprint at this update; control should be validated across datasets and camera trajectories.

works.paper_title: Warp-as-History: Generalizable Camera-Controlled Video Generation from One Training Video

works.name: Laplacian Surface Editing
works.paper_title: Laplacian Surface Editing
works.group: 控制柄、网格与局部形变模型
works.summary: 通过局部拉普拉斯坐标与控制柄约束实现保留几何细节的网格编辑，是局部形变表示的重要基础。
works.caveat: 依赖网格质量和约束布局，大幅旋转需要额外处理。

en.summary: Uses local Laplacian coordinates and handle constraints for detail-preserving mesh editing.
en.caveat: Depends on mesh quality and handle placement; large rotations need additional care.

en.summary: Computes shape-aware bounded biharmonic blending weights for point, bone and cage deformation handles.

works.name: Deep Image Homography Estimation
works.paper_title: Deep Image Homography Estimation
works.group: 单应性配准、图像拼接与基于网格的视频稳像

works.summary: 用模拟拉伸材料的潜空间形变函数一步移动 latent 像素位置，并以双边最近邻插值填补 warp 后的空洞，实现单步拖拽编辑。
works.caveat: latent 分辨率较低，精细结构与大幅拖拽仍依赖扩散修复。

en.summary: Moves latent pixels in one step with a latent warpage function that mimics stretched material, then fills warp-induced holes with bilateral nearest-neighbor interpolation for drag editing.
en.caveat: Latent resolution is coarse; fine structures and large drags still rely on diffusion repair.

works.name: Heckbert Texture Mapping & Image Warping
works.paper_title: Fundamentals of Texture Mapping and Image Warping
works.group: 可微采样与 Splatting
works.summary: 系统整理仿射、双线性与投影映射，并把纹理映射与图像 warping 中的重采样表述为重建、warp、预滤波与采样的统一流程，是抗混叠重采样的经典参考。
works.caveat: 以经典图形管线为背景，未涉及可微或学习式算子。

en.summary: Systematizes affine, bilinear and projective mappings and formulates resampling in texture mapping and image warping as reconstruction, warping, prefiltering and sampling, a classic reference for antialiased resampling.
en.caveat: Written for classical graphics pipelines; does not cover differentiable or learned operators.

works.name: WAFT
works.paper_title: WAFT: Warping-Alone Field Transforms for Optical Flow
works.group: 光流与稠密对应
works.summary: 用高分辨率特征 warping 取代代价体，在类 RAFT 迭代更新中仅依赖 warp 后的特征估计光流，以更低显存取得高精度。
works.caveat: 依赖迭代初始化，大位移下仍需多尺度或较好初值。

en.summary: Replaces cost volumes with high-resolution feature warping, estimating flow in RAFT-style iterative updates from warped features alone with lower memory and high accuracy.
en.caveat: Relies on iterative initialization; large displacements still need good initial estimates.

works.name: SMURF
works.paper_title: SMURF: Self-Teaching Multi-Frame Unsupervised RAFT with Full-Image Warping
works.group: 光流与稠密对应
works.summary: 以 RAFT 为骨干，用全图 warping 处理出界运动的光度损失、多帧自教学与遮挡估计进行无监督光流训练。
works.caveat: 光度一致性假设在光照变化与遮挡处失效。

en.summary: Trains RAFT without labels using full-image warping for out-of-frame motion in the photometric loss, multi-frame self-teaching and occlusion reasoning.
en.caveat: The photometric-consistency assumption breaks under illumination change and occlusion.

works.name: UnFlow
works.paper_title: UnFlow: Unsupervised Learning of Optical Flow with a Bidirectional Census Loss
works.group: 光流与稠密对应
works.summary: 用前后向 warping 的 census 光度损失、前后向一致性与遮挡掩码无监督训练 FlowNet。
works.caveat: 无监督目标在弱纹理和大位移区域仍较弱。

en.summary: Trains FlowNet without labels using census photometric losses on forward-backward warps, forward-backward consistency and occlusion masks.
en.caveat: The unsupervised objective remains weak in textureless and large-motion regions.

works.name: Unsupervised Deep Homography
works.paper_title: Unsupervised Deep Homography: A Fast and Robust Homography Estimation Model
works.group: 图像配准、拼接与视频稳像
works.summary: 通过可微 DLT 与空间变换层把预测的单应性用于 warping，以像素光度误差无监督训练单应性估计网络。
works.caveat: 单一单应性不能解释视差与非平面场景。

en.summary: Uses a differentiable DLT and spatial-transformer warping of predicted homographies to train homography estimation from photometric error without labels.
en.caveat: A single homography cannot explain parallax or nonplanar scenes.

works.name: Content-Aware Unsupervised Deep Homography
works.paper_title: Content-Aware Unsupervised Deep Homography Estimation
works.group: 图像配准、拼接与视频稳像
works.summary: 在特征空间比较 warp 后的图像并学习内容掩码，抑制运动物体与弱纹理区域对无监督单应性估计的干扰。
works.caveat: 仍限于近似平面或小视差场景。

en.summary: Compares warped images in feature space with learned content masks so moving objects and weak textures do less harm to unsupervised homography estimation.
en.caveat: Still limited to near-planar or low-parallax scenes.

works.name: Log-Euclidean Diffeomorphisms
works.paper_title: A Log-Euclidean Framework for Statistics on Diffeomorphisms
works.group: 医学图像配准与可逆形变
works.summary: 用平稳速度场的群指数参数化微分同胚，以 scaling-and-squaring 高效计算形变，并在对数域进行统计；后续学习式配准广泛采用这一积分方式。
works.caveat: 平稳速度场不能表示所有微分同胚路径。

en.summary: Parameterizes diffeomorphisms by group exponentials of stationary velocity fields, computes them efficiently by scaling and squaring, and performs statistics in the log domain; later learned registration widely adopts this integration.
en.caveat: Stationary velocity fields cannot represent every diffeomorphic path.

works.name: DARTEL
works.paper_title: A fast diffeomorphic image registration algorithm
works.group: 医学图像配准与可逆形变
works.summary: 以恒定速度场和指数映射建模微分同胚，并联合构建群体模板，是 SPM 中广泛使用的脑影像配准方法。
works.caveat: 主要面向组织分割图，跨对比度场景需额外处理。

en.summary: Models diffeomorphisms with constant velocity fields and exponentiation while building population templates, a widely used brain registration method in SPM.
en.caveat: Designed mainly for tissue maps; cross-contrast use needs extra handling.

works.name: Probabilistic Diffeomorphic VoxelMorph
works.paper_title: Unsupervised Learning for Fast Probabilistic Diffeomorphic Registration
works.group: 医学图像配准与可逆形变
works.summary: 网络预测速度场分布，并在网络内用 scaling-and-squaring 积分为微分同胚形变，配合空间变换层无监督训练。
works.caveat: 概率估计对先验与正则权重较敏感。

en.summary: Predicts a velocity-field distribution and integrates it into a diffeomorphic deformation inside the network by scaling and squaring, trained without labels through a spatial-transformer warp.
en.caveat: Uncertainty estimates are sensitive to priors and regularization weights.

works.name: Recursive Cascaded Networks
works.paper_title: Recursive Cascaded Networks for Unsupervised Medical Image Registration
works.group: 医学图像配准与可逆形变
works.summary: 级联多个子网络，每级对上一级 warp 后的图像预测增量形变，并逐级组合形变场，以处理大形变。
works.caveat: 级数增加会提高计算与显存开销。

en.summary: Cascades subnetworks that each predict an incremental deformation of the previously warped image and compose the fields to handle large deformations.
en.caveat: More cascades increase compute and memory cost.

works.name: Deep Voxel Flow
works.paper_title: Video Frame Synthesis using Deep Voxel Flow
works.group: 视频插帧与复原
works.summary: 预测时空体素流并对相邻帧做三线性采样，用于插帧与未来帧外推，无需光流标注。
works.caveat: 纯采样无法生成被遮挡区域的新内容。

en.summary: Predicts spatiotemporal voxel flow and trilinearly samples neighboring frames for interpolation and extrapolation without flow labels.
en.caveat: Pure sampling cannot create content for disoccluded regions.

works.name: Blind Video Temporal Consistency
works.paper_title: Learning Blind Video Temporal Consistency
works.group: 视频插帧与复原
works.summary: 用光流 warp 前后帧构造短期与长期时序损失，学习与具体任务无关的视频时序稳定网络，并以 warping 误差评测闪烁。
works.caveat: 依赖光流质量；遮挡处只能靠掩码排除。

en.summary: Builds short- and long-term temporal losses from flow-warped frames to learn task-agnostic video stabilization of per-frame outputs, and evaluates flicker with warping error.
en.caveat: Relies on flow quality; occlusions are only excluded by masks.

works.name: Liquid Warping GAN
works.paper_title: Liquid Warping GAN: A Unified Framework for Human Motion Imitation, Appearance Transfer and Novel View Synthesis
works.group: 人物动画、运动迁移与虚拟试衣
works.summary: 用三维人体网格计算源与目标之间的变换流，在特征空间进行 liquid warping 以保留纹理、身份与服装细节。
works.caveat: 依赖人体网格拟合质量，宽松服装与头发难以准确建模。

en.summary: Computes transformation flow from 3D body meshes between source and target and warps features with a liquid warping block to keep texture, identity and clothing detail.
en.caveat: Depends on body-mesh fitting; loose clothing and hair are hard to model.

works.name: ClothFlow
works.paper_title: ClothFlow: A Flow-Based Model for Clothed Person Generation
works.group: 人物动画、运动迁移与虚拟试衣
works.summary: 级联估计稠密外观流，把服装从源姿态 warp 到目标姿态，用于姿态引导人物生成与虚拟试衣。
works.caveat: 大幅遮挡与自遮挡时光流难以定义。

en.summary: Estimates dense appearance flow in a cascade to warp garments from source to target pose for pose-guided person generation and virtual try-on.
en.caveat: Flow is ill-defined under heavy occlusion and self-occlusion.

works.name: LivePortrait
works.paper_title: LivePortrait: Efficient Portrait Animation with Stitching and Retargeting Control
works.group: 人物动画、运动迁移与虚拟试衣
works.summary: 沿隐式关键点框架由关键点变换生成稠密 warping 场驱动源特征，并加入拼接与重定向模块，实现高效人像动画。
works.caveat: 大幅姿态和遮挡下 warp 场可能失真。

en.summary: Follows the implicit-keypoint framework, turning keypoint transforms into dense warping fields that drive source features, and adds stitching and retargeting modules for efficient portrait animation.
en.caveat: Warping fields can distort under large poses and occlusions.

works.name: UniCaMo / Track the Noise
works.paper_title: Track the Noise, Move the World: 3D-Grounded Motion-Consistent Noise for Controllable Video Generation
works.group: 噪声 Warping 与时序一致性
works.summary: 沿稀疏三维点轨迹 warp 参考帧的高斯噪声，并用虚拟球面噪声为相机运动新暴露区域提供全局一致的噪声，统一控制物体与相机运动。
works.caveat: 预印本；依赖三维点轨迹与深度估计质量。

en.summary: Warps reference-frame Gaussian noise along sparse 3D point tracks and uses a virtual spherical noise field for regions revealed by camera motion, jointly controlling object and camera motion.
en.caveat: Preprint; depends on 3D track and depth quality.

works.name: Text2Video-Zero
works.paper_title: Text2Video-Zero: Text-to-Image Diffusion Models are Zero-Shot Video Generators
works.group: 噪声 Warping 与时序一致性
works.summary: 对首帧 latent 按全局平移运动进行 warp 以生成后续帧初始 latent，并结合跨帧注意力，实现零训练文生视频。
works.caveat: 全局平移运动表达有限，难以生成复杂物体运动。

en.summary: Warps the first-frame latent by global translation to initialize later frames and combines this with cross-frame attention for training-free text-to-video generation.
en.caveat: Global translation is a limited motion model for complex object motion.

works.name: CoDeF
works.paper_title: CoDeF: Content Deformation Fields for Temporally Consistent Video Processing
works.group: 噪声 Warping 与时序一致性
works.summary: 把视频表示为规范内容场与逐帧时间形变场，在规范图像上处理后经形变场传播回各帧，实现时序一致的视频编辑。
works.caveat: 大幅非刚性运动和遮挡下规范图像难以覆盖全部内容。

en.summary: Represents video as a canonical content field plus per-frame temporal deformation fields, so edits on the canonical image propagate through the deformation to every frame.
en.caveat: A canonical image struggles to cover content under large nonrigid motion and occlusion.

works.name: GEN3C
works.paper_title: GEN3C: 3D-Informed World-Consistent Video Generation with Precise Camera Control
works.group: 相机、轨迹与运动可控生成
works.summary: 由逐像素深度构建点云三维缓存，沿用户相机轨迹重投影渲染后作为视频扩散条件，使生成专注于未观测区域。
works.caveat: 依赖深度估计质量；动态物体的缓存更新较难。

en.summary: Builds a point-cloud 3D cache from per-pixel depth, reprojects it along the user camera trajectory and conditions video diffusion on the renderings so generation focuses on unobserved regions.
en.caveat: Depends on depth quality; updating the cache for dynamic objects is difficult.

works.name: CamTrol
works.paper_title: Training-free Camera Control for Video Generation
works.group: 相机、轨迹与运动可控生成
works.summary: 在三维点云空间按相机运动重排图像布局，并据此重组带噪 latent 作为布局先验，实现零训练的相机控制。
works.caveat: 受单目深度与噪声重排策略限制，大幅视角变化下效果下降。

en.summary: Rearranges image layout through explicit camera motion in 3D point-cloud space and reorganizes noisy latents accordingly as a layout prior for training-free camera control.
en.caveat: Limited by monocular depth and latent rearrangement; quality drops under large viewpoint changes.

works.name: ViewCrafter
works.paper_title: ViewCrafter: Taming Video Diffusion Models for High-fidelity Novel View Synthesis
works.group: 相机、轨迹与运动可控生成
works.summary: 把稀疏视图的点云按目标相机重投影渲染，作为视频扩散条件补全缺失区域，并迭代扩展点云以扩大新视角范围。
works.caveat: 预印本记录；点云误差会传入生成结果。

en.summary: Reprojects point clouds from sparse views to target cameras, conditions video diffusion on the renderings to complete missing regions, and iteratively extends the point cloud for wider novel views.
en.caveat: Recorded as a preprint; point-cloud errors propagate into generated views.

works.name: DTAM
works.paper_title: DTAM: Dense tracking and mapping in real-time
works.group: 空间感知、深度与三维重建
works.summary: 对每个像素沿逆深度构建光度代价体，通过把参考帧 warp 到多帧计算误差，并以整图对齐跟踪相机，实现实时稠密单目重建。
works.caveat: 依赖 GPU 与光度一致性，弱纹理与光照变化下不稳定。

en.summary: Builds per-pixel photometric cost volumes over inverse depth by warping the reference frame into many frames, and tracks the camera by whole-image alignment for real-time dense monocular mapping.
en.caveat: Requires a GPU and photometric consistency; unstable in weak texture and lighting changes.

works.name: LSD-SLAM
works.paper_title: LSD-SLAM: Large-Scale Direct Monocular SLAM
works.group: 空间感知、深度与三维重建
works.summary: 在半稠密高梯度像素上用深度 warp 最小化光度误差直接估计 Sim(3) 位姿，构建大尺度单目 SLAM。
works.caveat: 对快速运动、卷帘快门和曝光变化敏感。

en.summary: Directly estimates Sim(3) poses by minimizing photometric error of depth-warped semi-dense high-gradient pixels for large-scale monocular SLAM.
en.caveat: Sensitive to fast motion, rolling shutter and exposure changes.

works.name: Direct Sparse Odometry (DSO)
works.paper_title: Direct Sparse Odometry
works.group: 空间感知、深度与三维重建
works.summary: 对稀疏点联合优化深度、位姿与光度标定，以重投影 warp 后的光度误差为目标，形成直接法视觉里程计。
works.caveat: 对光度标定与初始化要求较高。

en.summary: Jointly optimizes depth, poses and photometric calibration of sparse points using photometric error after reprojection warping, forming direct visual odometry.
en.caveat: Demands good photometric calibration and initialization.

works.name: Garg et al. Self-Supervised Depth
works.paper_title: Unsupervised CNN for Single View Depth Estimation: Geometry to the Rescue
works.group: 空间感知、深度与三维重建
works.summary: 用预测视差把立体对中的另一视图 warp 到当前视图，以重建误差训练单目深度网络，是自监督深度估计的早期工作。
works.caveat: 需要已标定立体对训练；遮挡区域无法重建。

en.summary: Warps the other stereo view with predicted disparity and trains a monocular depth network from reconstruction error, an early self-supervised depth method.
en.caveat: Requires calibrated stereo training pairs; occluded regions cannot be reconstructed.

works.name: Monodepth
works.paper_title: Unsupervised Monocular Depth Estimation with Left-Right Consistency
works.group: 空间感知、深度与三维重建
works.summary: 用可微双线性采样把左右视图互相 warp，并加入左右视差一致性损失训练单目深度。
works.caveat: 在遮挡边界和弱纹理区域仍有误差。

en.summary: Warps left and right views into each other by differentiable bilinear sampling and adds a left-right disparity consistency loss for monocular depth training.
en.caveat: Errors remain at occlusion boundaries and in weak texture.

works.name: View Interpolation
works.paper_title: View interpolation for image synthesis
works.group: 重投影与新视角合成
works.summary: 用预计算的像素对应（morph map）在相邻参考图像之间插值，快速合成中间视点，是基于图像渲染与视图 morphing 的早期工作。
works.caveat: 视点间隔大时线性插值不再准确，并产生空洞与重叠。

en.summary: Interpolates precomputed pixel correspondences (morph maps) between nearby reference images to synthesize intermediate viewpoints quickly, an early image-based rendering and view-morphing work.
en.caveat: Linear interpolation breaks down for wide baselines and produces holes and overlaps.

works.name: Plenoptic Modeling
works.paper_title: Plenoptic modeling: an image-based rendering system
works.group: 重投影与新视角合成
works.summary: 从柱面全景重建全光函数样本，并用基于视差的三维图像 warping 和遮挡兼容的绘制顺序合成新视角。
works.caveat: 依赖稠密对应，遮挡后出现的区域无法填补。

en.summary: Reconstructs plenoptic samples from cylindrical panoramas and synthesizes new views with disparity-based 3D image warping and an occlusion-compatible drawing order.
en.caveat: Requires dense correspondence; disoccluded regions remain unfilled.

works.name: Layered Depth Images (LDI)
works.paper_title: Layered depth images
works.group: 重投影与新视角合成
works.summary: 在单一视点的每条视线上存储多层深度与颜色，使三维 warping 后被遮挡层可以填补空洞，并给出高效的 splat 渲染。
works.caveat: 层数和采样分辨率限制了远离参考视点时的质量。

en.summary: Stores multiple depth and color layers along each ray of one viewpoint so 3D warping can fill holes from occluded layers, with efficient splat rendering.
en.caveat: Layer count and sampling resolution limit quality far from the reference view.

works.name: Appearance Flow
works.paper_title: View Synthesis by Appearance Flow
works.group: 重投影与新视角合成
works.summary: 预测从目标视图指向输入视图的稠密外观流并双线性采样像素，用于新视角合成，也成为后续服装 warping 的基础。
works.caveat: 只能复制可见像素，无法生成未观测内容。

en.summary: Predicts dense appearance flow from target to input views and bilinearly samples pixels for view synthesis; later garment-warping methods build on it.
en.caveat: Only copies visible pixels; cannot hallucinate unseen content.

works.name: NVS-Solver
works.paper_title: NVS-Solver: Video Diffusion Model as Zero-Shot Novel View Synthesizer
works.group: 重投影与新视角合成
works.summary: 把输入视图按目标位姿 warp 后作为场景先验，在采样中自适应调制视频扩散的 score 函数，实现零训练新视角合成。
works.caveat: 依赖深度质量；大视角变化下 warp 先验覆盖不足。

en.summary: Uses input views warped to target poses as scene priors and adaptively modulates the video-diffusion score during sampling for training-free novel view synthesis.
en.caveat: Depends on depth quality; warped priors cover little under large viewpoint changes.

works.name: SNARF
works.paper_title: SNARF: Differentiable Forward Skinning for Animating Non-Rigid Neural Implicit Shapes
works.group: 动态三维与 4D 场景
works.summary: 在规范空间学习前向蒙皮权重，通过迭代求根把形变空间点对应回规范空间，并用隐函数定理求梯度。
works.caveat: 求根可能存在多解，非骨架形变表达有限。

en.summary: Learns forward skinning weights in canonical space, finds canonical correspondences of deformed points by iterative root finding, and differentiates through the implicit function theorem.
en.caveat: Root finding can have multiple solutions; nonskeletal deformation is limited.

works.name: HumanNeRF
works.paper_title: HumanNeRF: Free-viewpoint Rendering of Moving People from Monocular Video
works.group: 动态三维与 4D 场景
works.summary: 用骨骼刚性运动加非刚性残差的运动场，把观察空间点映射到规范人体辐射场，实现单目视频人物自由视点渲染。
works.caveat: 依赖姿态估计质量，未观测侧面难以恢复。

en.summary: Maps observation-space points to a canonical human radiance field with skeletal rigid motion plus a nonrigid residual for free-viewpoint rendering from monocular video.
en.caveat: Depends on pose estimates; unseen sides are hard to recover.

works.name: DynIBaR
works.paper_title: DynIBaR: Neural Dynamic Image-Based Rendering
works.group: 动态三维与 4D 场景
works.summary: 用运动轨迹场把采样点投到相邻帧并聚合其特征，结合场景运动感知的体渲染，合成长时动态视频新视角。
works.caveat: 优化开销大，快速运动下轨迹估计不稳定。

en.summary: Uses motion trajectory fields to project samples into nearby frames and aggregate their features, with scene-motion-aware volume rendering for novel views of long dynamic videos.
en.caveat: Optimization is expensive; trajectories are unstable under fast motion.

works.name: OmniMotion
works.paper_title: Tracking Everything Everywhere All at Once
works.group: 动态三维与 4D 场景
works.summary: 用可逆神经网络在每帧局部空间与准三维规范体之间建立双射，实现全视频逐像素长程运动估计并可跨越遮挡。
works.caveat: 逐视频测试时优化，计算代价高。

en.summary: Builds invertible-network bijections between each frame and a quasi-3D canonical volume for full-length per-pixel motion that persists through occlusion.
en.caveat: Per-video test-time optimization is costly.

works.name: Cognitive Mapping and Planning (CMP)
works.paper_title: Cognitive Mapping and Planning for Visual Navigation
works.group: 空间推理与场景记忆
works.summary: 用自运动对上一时刻的俯视置信地图做可微 warp，再融合当前第一人称观测，联合学习建图与规划。
works.caveat: 依赖准确自运动；仿真到真实迁移有限。

en.summary: Differentiably warps the previous top-down belief map by egomotion before fusing the current first-person observation, learning mapping and planning jointly.
en.caveat: Relies on accurate egomotion; sim-to-real transfer is limited.

works.name: SDC-Net
works.paper_title: SDCNet: Video Prediction Using Spatially-Displaced Convolution
works.group: 世界模型与环境预测
works.summary: 为每个像素预测运动向量和核，在运动向量位移后的源位置施加核采样，结合流式 warping 与核方法预测未来帧。
works.caveat: 仍难以生成大面积遮挡后新出现的内容。

en.summary: Predicts a motion vector and kernel per pixel and applies the kernel at the displaced source location, combining flow-based warping and kernel synthesis for future-frame prediction.
en.caveat: Still struggles to create content revealed by large disocclusions.

works.name: TPS Trajectory Transfer
works.paper_title: Learning from Demonstrations Through the Use of Non-rigid Registration
works.group: 具身智能体、规划与控制
works.summary: 在示范与新场景点云之间拟合 TPS 非刚性配准，并用同一 warp 迁移示范轨迹，用于绳结等可形变物体操作。
works.caveat: 场景差异过大时配准失败，轨迹迁移不保证可行。

en.summary: Fits a TPS non-rigid registration between demonstration and test point clouds and transfers the demonstrated trajectory through the same warp for deformable-object manipulation such as knot tying.
en.caveat: Registration fails for very different scenes, and transferred trajectories are not guaranteed feasible.

works.name: AVDC
works.paper_title: Learning to Act from Actionless Videos through Dense Correspondences
works.group: 具身智能体、规划与控制
works.summary: 先合成机器人执行任务的视频，再由帧间稠密光流与深度求解物体的刚体变换，从而闭式推出动作。
works.caveat: 刚体假设不适用于可形变物体；视频生成误差会传到动作。

en.summary: Synthesizes task-execution videos, then solves object rigid transforms from dense inter-frame flow and depth to infer actions in closed form.
en.caveat: The rigid assumption excludes deformable objects; video-generation errors propagate to actions.

background_references.name: Rigid / Similarity / Affine / Homography
background_references.group: 参数化几何与运动估计
background_references.summary: 从全局刚体到投影变换；单应性可描述平面场景或固定光心纯旋转下的视图关系
background_references.caveat: 通用三维平移、视差与非刚性运动不能由单一矩阵解释

en.summary: Global rigid, similarity, affine and projective maps provide compact coordinate transformations. A homography models a plane or a change of view under pure rotation about a fixed optical center.
en.caveat: One global matrix cannot generally explain 3D translation with parallax or nonrigid motion.
